{{Quote|Hmmm...It's some kind of...ballet?|Mara Jade|audio=SomeKindofBallet.flac|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The '''Katraasii Droid Ballet Studio''' was located in the [[Katraasii Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]]. Catering solely to [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the studio's doors remained locked to [[Species/Legends|organics]], opening only at a droid's approach. Inside, the space opened to a large hall for dance performances on a lower floor, accessible via ramp from the viewing platform at street-level. An unlit, ramped path traveled up and around to open on a second floor balcony that overlooked the street.<ref name="MOTS" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] snuck into the studio behind a slow-walking, [[Color/Legends|gold]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. Inside, Jade witnessed eight [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK]] droids and eight other protocol droids executing a well-timed, tightly choreographed dance.<ref name="MOTS" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I love building big city levels, and I had lots of fun hiding "easter eggs" all over this one.|Ryan Kaufman, on designing the Katraasii Spaceport levels|<ref name="BTS blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
This building appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. If the player followed a particularly slow-moving protocol droid, they could enter behind and view the dancing droids. Reaching the room did not affect or advance the game, but it contained large health and [[Personal energy shield/Legends|shield]] replenishes, as well as [[energy cell]]s. The second floor lookout contained more cells and [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="MOTS" /> Level designer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] created the expansive streets of Katraasii Spaceport, including the Droid Ballet Studio [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] in the first of two levels.<ref name="BTS blog" />
